row.title: Second Tenant is wired as a seed: IDEA, lifecycle, clock and progress row
row.body: The seed's own D1 (c7461ff8) holds 12 tick_runs rows from 2026-11-21 23:00 to 2026-11-22 00:50, and ops/deploys.jsonl has a live_ok row for ultrastable-seed-second-tenant, yet seedlife read it as not a seed: no IDEA.md and an empty lifecycle. Added IDEA.md with a system test, lifecycle answers (worker ultrastable-seed-second-tenant, verify /health expecting the org name, privacy n/a), clock seed-second-tenant-tick and a progress row. seedlife now counts doctrine/seed-deploys.json as the deploy lane owning a seed worker, since deploy-oidc.mjs redeploys listed seeds after every platform deploy.
